dialogues.jp: 晴れて今日から、自由の身！
dialogues.en: On this beautiful day, I can do what I want!
dialogues.text: On this beautiful day, I can do what I want!

dialogues.jp:
日曜日でもない、春休みでもない素晴らしき休
日を謳歌する。
dialogues.en:
It's not a Sunday, nor spring break yet, but simply the
glory of a rest day for us graduates.
dialogues.text:
It's not a Sunday, nor spring break yet, but simply the
glory of a rest day for us graduates.

dialogues.jp: 学校では、来週まで授業が行われているらしい。
dialogues.en:
It seems the school will continue to hold lessons through
next week, though.
dialogues.text:
It seems the school will continue to hold lessons through
next week, though.

dialogues.jp:
去年までは、のうのうと遊び呆ける卒業生達を
恨めしそうに見ていたものだが、今年は俺がヒー
ローだ。
dialogues.en:
Unlike last year, where I was jealous of the graduates, this
time, I'm the hero!
dialogues.text:
Unlike last year, where I was jealous of the graduates, this
time, I'm the hero!

dialogues.jp:
そんな気分だから、咲き乱れる桜の花もいつも
より美しく感じるというものだ。
dialogues.en:
With that mood, the ever-blooming sakura petals seemed even
more pleasant than usual.
dialogues.text:
With that mood, the ever-blooming sakura petals seemed even
more pleasant than usual.

dialogues.jp: 「そろそろ、かな……」
dialogues.en: "It's just about time..."
dialogues.text: "It's just about time..."

dialogues.jp:
そろそろ、昼休憩の時間だ。月城も授業を終え
てあの草……ロスキルラベンダーの様子を見に
来るはずだ。
dialogues.en:
Just about time for lunch period. Tsukishiro'd surely check
on that plant... that Roskill Lavender, once lessons end.
dialogues.text:
Just about time for lunch period. Tsukishiro'd surely check
on that plant... that Roskill Lavender, once lessons end.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、公園の時計を見ながら、頃合いを計り、
学校へ向かう。
dialogues.en:
I looked at the clock in the park. Figuring that it was a
suitable time, I started heading for the school.
dialogues.text:
I looked at the clock in the park. Figuring that it was a
suitable time, I started heading for the school.

dialogues.jp:
昨日、さくらから聞いたこと、ロスキルラベン
ダーは日本で花を咲かせることはない、それを
伝えなければならないと思った。
dialogues.en:
I had to try and tell Alice what I had heard from Sakura
yesterday; that there's no way the Roskill Lavender can
bloom in Japan.
dialogues.text:
I had to try and tell Alice what I had heard from Sakura
yesterday; that there's no way the Roskill Lavender can
bloom in Japan.

dialogues.jp:
いつか知る、つぼみすらつけないという事実は
きっと早く知った方がいい。
dialogues.en:
She may well have to find out sooner or later, but in this
case, it'd probably be much better if it's sooner.
dialogues.text:
She may well have to find out sooner or later, but in this
case, it'd probably be much better if it's sooner.

dialogues.jp: 期待の大きさは、待っている時間に比例する。
dialogues.en: The longer I wait, the bigger the expectations will grow.
dialogues.text: The longer I wait, the bigger the expectations will grow.

dialogues.jp:
だから、俺はたとえ月城を悲しませることになっ
ても、後悔はすまいと思った。
dialogues.en:
That's why, despite the possibility of seeing Tsukishiro's
sad face, I wanted to leave no regrets behind.
dialogues.text:
That's why, despite the possibility of seeing Tsukishiro's
sad face, I wanted to leave no regrets behind.

dialogues.jp: 「よぉ、月城」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Tsukishiro."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Tsukishiro."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉、先輩」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura, senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura, senpai."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、ちょうどロスキルラベンダーに水をやっ
ていたところだった。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro was giving the Roskill Lavender some water.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro was giving the Roskill Lavender some water.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……今日は、元気みたい」
dialogues.en: "...It seems healthy today."
dialogues.text: "...It seems healthy today."

dialogues.jp:
月城が、少しだけ嬉しそうな顔をして、そう言っ
た。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishios spoke, with joy clear on that
usually-expressionless face.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishios spoke, with joy clear on that
usually-expressionless face.

dialogues.jp: 「あのさ、月城」
dialogues.en: "You know, Tsukishiro..."
dialogues.text: "You know, Tsukishiro..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "Well..."
dialogues.text: "Well..."

dialogues.jp: ここまできて、俺は｛ちゅうちょ／躊躇｝した。
dialogues.en: At the crucial point, I hesitated.
dialogues.text: At the crucial point, I hesitated.

dialogues.jp: 果たして本当に伝えていいのだろうか。
dialogues.en: Was this really the right thing to do?
dialogues.text: Was this really the right thing to do?

dialogues.jp: もしかしたら、咲くかも知れない。
dialogues.en: There's no knowing whether it'd actually bloom after all.
dialogues.text: There's no knowing whether it'd actually bloom after all.

dialogues.jp:
日本では、育つことが難しいと言われた草がこ
こまで立派に育ったのだ。
dialogues.en:
The very fact that this plant exists here, despite how
delicate it is, and how difficult it's supposed to grow...
dialogues.text:
The very fact that this plant exists here, despite how
delicate it is, and how difficult it's supposed to grow...

dialogues.jp:
つぼみだってつくかもしれない。花だって咲く
かもしれない。
dialogues.en: It might just bud. A flower might just bloom.
dialogues.text: It might just bud. A flower might just bloom.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……今度こそ」
dialogues.en: "...This should do it."
dialogues.text: "...This should do it."

dialogues.jp:
水をやり終えた月城が、葉に水玉を載せている
ロスキルラベンダーを軽くつついた。
dialogues.en:
Finishing her watering, a lone waterdrop was hanging from a
leaf of the Roskill Lavender.
dialogues.text:
Finishing her watering, a lone waterdrop was hanging from a
leaf of the Roskill Lavender.

dialogues.jp:
水玉が、ぷるんと弾けるようにして地面に飛び
散る。
dialogues.en:
It then dropped to the groound, exploding into a splatter of
smaller drops.
dialogues.text:
It then dropped to the groound, exploding into a splatter of
smaller drops.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai."

dialogues.jp: 月城が俺の方を向く。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro faced me.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro faced me.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "...What's wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「あのさ……」
dialogues.en: "You know..."
dialogues.text: "You know..."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、なにもあきらめろと説得しに来た訳じゃ
あない。
dialogues.en: I didn't come here to convince her to give up.
dialogues.text: I didn't come here to convince her to give up.

dialogues.jp: 草を育てるのをやめろといいに来た訳じゃない。
dialogues.en:
Nor did I come here to tell her to stop trying to grow that
plant.
dialogues.text:
Nor did I come here to tell her to stop trying to grow that
plant.

dialogues.jp:
愛情を持って草の世話をするのは、いいことだ
と思うし、あの草だってここまで育ててもらっ
てきっと喜んでいる。
dialogues.en:
Her feelings of love for the plant was clear; it would be an
awesome situation if it actually bloomed.
dialogues.text:
Her feelings of love for the plant was clear; it would be an
awesome situation if it actually bloomed.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、……ただ、過度の期待はしない方がいい、
そう伝えるだけだ。
dialogues.en: Just... I just didn't want her to get too hopeful about it.
dialogues.text: Just... I just didn't want her to get too hopeful about it.

dialogues.jp:
「俺の知り合いで、植物にすごく詳しいヤツが
　いてさ」
dialogues.en:
"Someone I know, told me that that plant is a very difficult
one to grow."
dialogues.text:
"Someone I know, told me that that plant is a very difficult
one to grow."

dialogues.jp: 月城が、半ば首を傾げながら俺を見る。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro's eyes kept gazing at me, her full attention on
me now.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro's eyes kept gazing at me, her full attention on
me now.

dialogues.jp:
「ロスキルラベンダーって言うんだってな、そ
　の草。なんでも北欧の方の花だって？」
dialogues.en:
"It's called Roskill Lavender, and apparently only grows in
Scandinavian countries, or something?"
dialogues.text:
"It's called Roskill Lavender, and apparently only grows in
Scandinavian countries, or something?"

dialogues.jp:
月城が｛けげん／怪訝｝そうな表情を浮かべた後、静かにこ
くんと頷いた。
dialogues.en:
Although a bout of dubiousness crept into her face, she
continued to display complete attentiveness.
dialogues.text:
Although a bout of dubiousness crept into her face, she
continued to display complete attentiveness.

dialogues.jp:
「そいつが言うには、ロスキルラベンダーって
　ヤツは気候の関係で、日本じゃ育たない植物
　なんだと」
dialogues.en:
"That person said that, thanks to the climate of Japan,
Roskill Lavenders can't be grown here."
dialogues.text:
"That person said that, thanks to the climate of Japan,
Roskill Lavenders can't be grown here."

dialogues.jp:
ゆっくりと草に目をやる月城。草は、弱々しい
が立派に根を張っている。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro's eyes slowly turned to the plant, looking as
weak as ever.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro's eyes slowly turned to the plant, looking as
weak as ever.

dialogues.jp:
「そこまで育ったのは、あり得ないことではな
　いけれど、ほとんど奇跡に近いくらいらしい。
　そして──」
dialogues.en:
"It's not impossible for a plant like that to have grown
here, but it'd be more closer to a miracle than anything
else. And--"
dialogues.text:
"It's not impossible for a plant like that to have grown
here, but it'd be more closer to a miracle than anything
else. And--"

dialogues.jp:
月城の表情が、暗く沈んでいく。しかし、俺は
もう止めることができない。
dialogues.en:
Her face grew more gloomy by the second. But I couldn't stop
now.
dialogues.text:
Her face grew more gloomy by the second. But I couldn't stop
now.

dialogues.jp:
「──日本の気候では、ロスキルラベンダーが
　つぼみをつけることはないんだって」
dialogues.en:
"--A Roskill Lavender won't be able to bud in Japan's
climate."
dialogues.text:
"--A Roskill Lavender won't be able to bud in Japan's
climate."

dialogues.jp:
月城がびくんと肩を震わせる。そして、下唇を
きゅっと噛みながら俺を見上げた。
dialogues.en:
Her shoulders started to tremble. She bit her lower lip,
looking up at me.
dialogues.text:
Her shoulders started to tremble. She bit her lower lip,
looking up at me.

dialogues.jp:
「つぼみも花もつけないまま、枯れていくだろ
　うって」
dialogues.en: "And if it can't bud flowers, it'd wilt."
dialogues.text: "And if it can't bud flowers, it'd wilt."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……咲きます」
dialogues.en: "...It will bloom."
dialogues.text: "...It will bloom."

dialogues.jp: 月城が、ぼそりとそう言った。
dialogues.en: Her voice was cracking as she whispered.
dialogues.text: Her voice was cracking as she whispered.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……花は、咲きます」
dialogues.en: "...A flower will bloom from it."
dialogues.text: "...A flower will bloom from it."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「でも、元気そうに見えて、その草はずっと病
　気にかかったままじゃないか」
dialogues.en:
"But look at it... it's never really looked healthy, always
on the verge of wilting..."
dialogues.text:
"But look at it... it's never really looked healthy, always
on the verge of wilting..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……この花が咲かないと、私」
dialogues.en: "...If it doesn't bloom, I..."
dialogues.text: "...If it doesn't bloom, I..."

dialogues.jp: 月城の表情が歪んでいく。
dialogues.en: Her expression was strained.
dialogues.text: Her expression was strained.

dialogues.jp:
目尻に涙がたまり、それが溢れ、頬を伝って、
ゆっくりと落ちていく。
dialogues.en:
Tears were forming in the corners of her eyes, and slowly
started rolling down her cheeks.
dialogues.text:
Tears were forming in the corners of her eyes, and slowly
started rolling down her cheeks.

dialogues.jp: 月城は手袋を外し、人形に触れる。
dialogues.en:
She quietly removed her gloves, and stroked the doll once
more.
dialogues.text:
She quietly removed her gloves, and stroked the doll once
more.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「……きっと、咲くよ」
dialogues.en: "...It'd definitely bloom."
dialogues.text: "...It'd definitely bloom."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「……頑張っていれば、いつか、咲くよ」
dialogues.en: "...If we work hard, it'd bloom someday."
dialogues.text: "...If we work hard, it'd bloom someday."

dialogues.jp:
胸の上で、ぎゅうっと強く抱きしめた人形の身
体が歪む。
dialogues.en:
Her entire body was shivering, as she held the doll tightly
to her chest.
dialogues.text:
Her entire body was shivering, as she held the doll tightly
to her chest.

dialogues.jp: 「俺は、あきらめろって言ってる訳じゃない」
dialogues.en: "I didn't mean for you to give up."
dialogues.text: "I didn't mean for you to give up."

dialogues.jp:
「ただ、その草がどういう状況なのかを知って
　ほしくて」
dialogues.en:
"I just wanted you to know the full extent of the
situation..."
dialogues.text:
"I just wanted you to know the full extent of the
situation..."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「……それでも、一生懸命、育てるよ」
dialogues.en:
"...Even so, we'd continue putting our all into making it
grow."
dialogues.text:
"...Even so, we'd continue putting our all into making it
grow."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「きっとロスキルラベンダーは答えてくれる」
dialogues.en: "This Roskill Lavender will surely answer us."
dialogues.text: "This Roskill Lavender will surely answer us."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「花を咲かせて、願いを叶えてくれる」
dialogues.en: "And when it blooms, our wish will come true."
dialogues.text: "And when it blooms, our wish will come true."

dialogues.jp:
歪んだ身体のままの人形が、いつもの調子で、
そう言った。
dialogues.en:
Being held by such a quivering body, the doll itself seemed
to remain calm.
dialogues.text:
Being held by such a quivering body, the doll itself seemed
to remain calm.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「……ボクとアリスは、花が咲くって信じてる」
dialogues.en: "...Alice and I believe that a flower will bloom."
dialogues.text: "...Alice and I believe that a flower will bloom."

dialogues.jp:
人形がそう言うと、月城はくるりと俺に背を向
け、校舎の方へ走っていった。
dialogues.en:
Upon the doll saying that, Alice ran past me and behind, and
towards the school building.
dialogues.text:
Upon the doll saying that, Alice ran past me and behind, and
towards the school building.

dialogues.jp: 声をかける間もないくらいに速く。
dialogues.en: A speed at which my voice wouldn't be able to reach her.
dialogues.text: A speed at which my voice wouldn't be able to reach her.

dialogues.jp: 追いつく間もないくらいに速く。
dialogues.en: A speed at which I wouldn't be able to catch her.
dialogues.text: A speed at which I wouldn't be able to catch her.

dialogues.jp: 「やっぱ、言わない方がよかったのかな……」
dialogues.en: "Maybe I shouldn't have said anything at all..."
dialogues.text: "Maybe I shouldn't have said anything at all..."

dialogues.jp: 予想はしていた。
dialogues.en: I predicted this, though.
dialogues.text: I predicted this, though.

dialogues.jp:
俺の言葉が、月城を悲しませてしまうだろうこ
とは、ある程度予想はしていた。
dialogues.en: Her sad reaction to my words, I was fully expecting it.
dialogues.text: Her sad reaction to my words, I was fully expecting it.

dialogues.jp: けれど、言わずにはいられなかった。
dialogues.en: Yet, I still felt that I shouldn't have said it.
dialogues.text: Yet, I still felt that I shouldn't have said it.

dialogues.jp:
ロスキルラベンダーのことを伝えた時の、月城
の悲しそうな顔。
dialogues.en:
Her sorrowful face when I told her about the Rosekill
Lavender...
dialogues.text:
Her sorrowful face when I told her about the Rosekill
Lavender...

dialogues.jp: 俺は、やはり後悔をした。
dialogues.en:
It was one I regretted ever making, and one I could never
forget.
dialogues.text:
It was one I regretted ever making, and one I could never
forget.

dialogues.jp: ◆花が咲くって信じてる◆
dialogues.en: ◆Believing That It'll Bloom◆
dialogues.text: ◆Believing That It'll Bloom◆

dialogues.jp:
俺は、さくらに聞いたことを黙っていることが
できず、月城に、日本でロスキルラベンダーの
花が咲くことはほぼ無理だと伝えた。
dialogues.en:
Not able to keep quiet about what Sakura told me, I repeated
to Alice that expecting the Rosekill Lavender to bloom in
Japan was unreasonable.
dialogues.text:
Not able to keep quiet about what Sakura told me, I repeated
to Alice that expecting the Rosekill Lavender to bloom in
Japan was unreasonable.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、月城は、涙目になりながら、絶対に咲
くのだと、いつになく、感情を露わにしていう
のだった。
dialogues.en:
But Tsukishiro, with tears falling from her eyes, exposed
her feelings to me, saying that it'd surely bloom, someday.
dialogues.text:
But Tsukishiro, with tears falling from her eyes, exposed
her feelings to me, saying that it'd surely bloom, someday.

dialogues.jp:
そして、声をかける間もなく、どこかへ行って
しまった……。
dialogues.en: Then she ran off, before I could call out to her.
dialogues.text: Then she ran off, before I could call out to her.

dialogues.jp:
ある程度は、予想はしていたものの、あの月城
の悲しそうな顔を思い出すと、やはり後悔せざ
るをえなかった……。
dialogues.en:
I knew it was going to happen, but remembering her sorrowful
face made me regret ever doing it.
dialogues.text:
I knew it was going to happen, but remembering her sorrowful
face made me regret ever doing it.
